name: naxriscv-gshare-4kib
description: NaxRiscv's direction predictor as configured by naxriscv.Gen: GSharePlugin(memBytes = 4 KiB, historyWidth = 24, counterWidth = 2), 16384 two-bit counters. The RTL index takes 13 bits: reversed PC bits above the slice xor the low history bits.

approximations: standard gshare index, not the RTL's reversed-PC hash
13 effective history bits (the RTL truncates the 24-bit history to the index width)
training at retirement after a fixed delay; the RTL trains at its commit-time learn port
exact committed-path history; the RTL predicts with speculative history
